{{Top|leg}}
A '''wallball court''' was a sealed court with two goals, which was used to play [[wallball]] in. One of the goals was worth one points, and the other two. The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] maintained several wallball courts on its [[Recreation Deck]].
